      { phrase: 'language and culture', weight: 5 }, { phrase: 'humanities', weight: 4 },
      { phrase: 'ciencias humanas', weight: 4 }, { phrase: 'crisis educativa', weight: 4 },
      { phrase: 'migration perceptions', weight: 5 }, { phrase: 'perceptions', weight: 3 },
      { phrase: 'migration survey', weight: 5 }, { phrase: 'reinsertion', weight: 3 },
      { phrase: 'reinsercion', weight: 3 }, { phrase: 'reintegration', weight: 3 },
      { phrase: 'lectora', weight: 2 }, { phrase: 'pensamiento pedagogico', weight: 4 },
      { phrase: 'educacion cosmopolita', weight: 4 },
      { phrase: 'citizenship', weight: 3 }, { phrase: 'community', weight: 2 }, { phrase: 'justice', weight: 2 },
    ],
  },
];

function normalizeText(value: string): string {
  return value.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

function includesPhrase(text: string, phrase: string): boolean {
  return ` ${text} `.includes(` ${normalizeText(phrase)} `);
}

/** Return a transparent temporary suggestion only when one line clearly leads. */
export function suggestEcmcResearchLine(title: string): ResearchLineSuggestion | undefined {
  const titleText = normalizeText(title);
  const scores = DICTIONARY.map(rule => {
    const titleMatches = rule.keywords.filter(keyword => includesPhrase(titleText, keyword.phrase));
    return {
      line: rule.line,
      score: titleMatches.reduce((sum, keyword) => sum + keyword.weight, 0),
      matchedKeywords: titleMatches.map(keyword => keyword.phrase),
    };
  }).sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score);

  const [best, second] = scores;
  if (!best || best.score < 3 || best.score - (second?.score || 0) < 1.5) return undefined;

  return {
    line: best.line,
    strength: best.score >= 5 && best.score - (second?.score || 0) >= 2.5 ? 'alta' : 'media',
    matchedKeywords: best.matchedKeywords,
  };
}


===== src\services\exportService.ts =====

import * as XLSX from 'xlsx';
import { ScientificProduct, FilterState, TeacherUser, TeacherMetrics, PROJECT_STATUS_LABELS } from '../types';
import { SCHOOLS } from '../constants/schools';
import { productDateValue, productCitationValue, productCitationLabel, productStatusLabel } from './productPresentation';
import { openPrintableDocument } from './printDocument';
import bricolageFontUrl from '../assets/fonts/bricolage-grotesque-latin-wght-normal.woff2?url';
import sourceSansFontUrl from '../assets/fonts/source-sans-3-latin-wght-normal.woff2?url';

function doiForDisplay(product: ScientificProduct): string | undefined {
  return product.status === 'verificado' ? product.doi : undefined;
}

export interface ExportMetadata {
  filters: FilterState;
  totalRecords: number;
  generatedAt: string;
  institution: string;
  school: string;
}

function escapeHtml(value: unknown): string {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => ({
    '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;',
  })[character] || character);
}

function csvCell(value: unknown): string {
  const text = String(value ?? '');
  const safeText = /^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(text) ? `'${text}` : text;
  return `"${safeText.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
}

export const exportService = {
  /**
   * Genera y descarga archivo CSV con codificación UTF-8 y BOM
   */
  exportToCsv(products: ScientificProduct[], meta: ExportMetadata, fileName = 'produccion_cientifica_ecmc.csv'): boolean {
    if (!products || products.length === 0) {
      return false;
    }

    const includeSource = products.some(product => product.bibliographicSource);
    const headers = [
      'ID Sistema',
      'Tipo de Producto',
      'Título',
      'Autores / Investigadores',
      'Año',
      'Fecha de publicación / inicio',
      'Línea de Investigación',
      'Estado Oficial',
      'Identificador (DOI / Código)',
      'Medio / Revista / Fondo',
      'Estado del proyecto',
      'Participantes del proyecto',
      'Duración del proyecto (meses)',
      'Productos esperados',
      'Citas Registradas',
      'Fecha Registro',
      ...(includeSource ? ['Fuente', 'Tipo en la fuente', 'Cuartil SJR', 'SJR Score', 'ORCID de investigadores vinculados', 'Método de asignación de línea'] : []),
    ];

    const rows = products.map((p) => [
      p.id,
      p.type === 'publicacion' ? 'Publicación Científica' : 'Proyecto de Investigación',
      p.title,
      p.authors.join('; '),
      p.year,
      productDateValue(p),
      p.researchLine,
      productStatusLabel(p),
      doiForDisplay(p) || p.projectCode || 'N/A',
      p.venue || p.fundingVenue || 'N/A',
      p.projectStatus ? PROJECT_STATUS_LABELS[p.projectStatus] : 'N/A',
      (p.projectParticipants || []).join('; '),
      p.projectDurationMonths ?? '',
      (p.expectedProducts || []).join('; '),
      productCitationValue(p),
      new Date(p.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('es-EC'),
      ...(includeSource ? [p.bibliographicSource?.dataset, p.bibliographicSource?.publicationType,
        p.bibliographicSource?.sjrQuartile, p.bibliographicSource?.sjrScore,
        p.bibliographicSource?.researcherOrcids.join('; '),
        p.bibliographicSource?.researchLineClassification ? 'Sugerencia temporal por diccionario de palabras clave' : 'Sin asignación automática'] : []),
    ].map(csvCell));

    // Encabezado de metadatos institucionales
    const metaHeader = [
      `# SIMAPC - Sistema de Información, Monitoreo y Administración de la Producción Científica`,
      `# ${meta.school} - ${meta.institution}`,
      `# Fecha de Generación: ${meta.generatedAt}`,
      `# Total Registros Exportados: ${meta.totalRecords}`,
      `# Filtros Aplicados: Tipo=${meta.filters.productType}; Línea=${meta.filters.researchLine}; Periodo=${meta.filters.periodYear}`,
    ].map(csvCell).join('\r\n') + '\r\n';

    const csvContent = '\uFEFF' + metaHeader + [headers.map(csvCell).join(','), ...rows.map((r) => r.join(','))].join('\r\n');

    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.setAttribute('download', fileName);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    return true;
  },

  /**
   * Genera y descarga un libro de trabajo auténtico de Excel (.xlsx)
   */
  exportToExcel(products: ScientificProduct[], meta: ExportMetadata, fileName = 'produccion_cientifica_ecmc.xlsx'): boolean {
    if (!products || products.length === 0) {
      return false;
    }

    const includeSource = products.some(product => product.bibliographicSource);
    const data = products.map((p) => ({
      'ID Sistema': p.id,
      'Tipo de Producto': p.type === 'publicacion' ? 'Publicación Científica' : 'Proyecto de Investigación',
      'Título': p.title,
      'Autores / Investigadores': p.authors.join('; '),
      'Año': p.year,
      'Fecha de publicación / inicio': productDateValue(p),
      'Línea de Investigación': p.researchLine,
      'Estado de verificación': productStatusLabel(p),
      'Identificador Digital / Código': doiForDisplay(p) || p.projectCode || 'N/A',
      'Medio de Difusión / Fondo': p.venue || p.fundingVenue || 'N/A',
      'Estado del proyecto': p.projectStatus ? PROJECT_STATUS_LABELS[p.projectStatus] : 'N/A',
      'Participantes del proyecto': (p.projectParticipants || []).join('; '),
      'Duración del proyecto (meses)': p.projectDurationMonths ?? '',
      'Productos esperados': (p.expectedProducts || []).join('; '),
      'Citas Indexadas': productCitationValue(p) ?? '',
      'Fecha Registro': new Date(p.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('es-EC'),
      ...(includeSource ? {
        'Fuente': p.bibliographicSource?.dataset || '',
        'Tipo en la fuente': p.bibliographicSource?.publicationType || '',
        'Cuartil SJR': p.bibliographicSource?.sjrQuartile || '',
        'SJR Score': p.bibliographicSource?.sjrScore ?? '',
        'ORCID de investigadores vinculados': p.bibliographicSource?.researcherOrcids.join('; ') || '',
        'Método de asignación de línea': p.bibliographicSource?.researchLineClassification ? 'Sugerencia temporal por diccionario de palabras clave' : 'Sin asignación automática',
      } : {}),
    }));

    const worksheet = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(data);

    // Ajuste de anchos de columna automáticos
    worksheet['!cols'] = [
      { wch: 12 }, // ID
      { wch: 22 }, // Tipo
      { wch: 55 }, // Título
      { wch: 40 }, // Autores
      { wch: 8 },  // Año
      { wch: 24 }, // Fecha
      { wch: 45 }, // Línea
      { wch: 14 }, // Estado
      { wch: 30 }, // Identificador
      { wch: 35 }, // Medio
      { wch: 18 }, // Estado del proyecto
      { wch: 40 }, // Participantes
      { wch: 22 }, // Duración
      { wch: 45 }, // Productos esperados
      { wch: 14 }, // Citas
      { wch: 15 }, // Fecha
    ];

    const workbook = XLSX.utils.book_new();
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(workbook, worksheet, 'Producción Científica ECMC');

    // Hoja secundaria con metadatos de la consulta
    const metaData = [
      { Parámetro: 'Portal', Valor: 'SIMAPC' },
      { Parámetro: 'Escuela', Valor: meta.school },
      { Parámetro: 'Institución', Valor: meta.institution },
      { Parámetro: 'Fecha Generación', Valor: meta.generatedAt },
      { Parámetro: 'Registros Exportados', Valor: meta.totalRecords },
      { Parámetro: 'Filtro Tipo', Valor: meta.filters.productType },
      { Parámetro: 'Filtro Línea', Valor: meta.filters.researchLine },
      { Parámetro: 'Filtro Periodo', Valor: meta.filters.periodYear },
    ];
    const metaWorksheet = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(metaData);
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(workbook, metaWorksheet, 'Metadatos de Consulta');

    XLSX.writeFile(workbook, fileName);
    return true;
  },

  /**
   * Genera vista imprimible o PDF del reporte filtrado
   */
  async exportToPrintablePdf(products: ScientificProduct[], meta: ExportMetadata): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!products || products.length === 0) {
      return false;
    }

    const schoolAccent = SCHOOLS.find(school => meta.school.includes(school.code) || meta.school === school.name)?.accent ?? '#252321';

    const tableRowsHtml = products
      .map(
        (p) => `
      <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #E5E7EB; font-size: 11px;">
        <td style="padding: 8px 6px; font-weight: bold; color: #111827;">${escapeHtml(p.id)}</td>
        <td style="padding: 8px 6px;">
          <span style="display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; background: ${
            p.type === 'publicacion' ? '#EFF6FF; color: #1D4ED8' : '#F0FDF4; color: #15803D'
          };">
            ${p.type === 'publicacion' ? 'Publicación' : 'Proyecto'}
          </span>
        </td>
        <td style="padding: 8px 6px; max-width: 320px;">
          <div style="font-weight: 600; color: #111827; margin-bottom: 2px;">${escapeHtml(p.title)}</div>
          <div style="color: #6B7280; font-size: 10px;">${escapeHtml(p.authors.join(', '))}</div>
          <div style="color: #9CA3AF; font-size: 9px; margin-top: 2px;">${escapeHtml(p.venue || p.fundingVenue || '')}</div>
          ${p.bibliographicSource ? `<div style="font-size: 9px; margin-top: 2px;">Fuente: ${escapeHtml(p.bibliographicSource.dataset)} · ${escapeHtml(p.bibliographicSource.publicationType)}${p.bibliographicSource.sjrQuartile ? ` · SJR ${escapeHtml(p.bibliographicSource.sjrQuartile)}` : ''}${p.bibliographicSource.researchLineClassification ? ` · Línea sugerida temporalmente por diccionario: ${escapeHtml(p.bibliographicSource.researchLineClassification.matchedKeywords.join(', '))}` : ''}</div>` : ''}
        </td>
        <td style="padding: 8px 6px; color: #374151; font-size: 10px;">${escapeHtml(p.researchLine)}</td>
        <td style="padding: 8px 6px; text-align: center; color: #374151;">${escapeHtml(productDateValue(p))}</td>
        <td style="padding: 8px 6px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px; color: #4B5563;">
          ${doiForDisplay(p) ? `DOI: ${escapeHtml(doiForDisplay(p))}` : p.projectCode ? `Cód: ${escapeHtml(p.projectCode)}` : '—'}
        </td>
        <td style="padding: 8px 6px; text-align: center;">
          <span style="display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; ${
            p.status === 'verificado'
              ? 'background: #ECFDF5; color: #047857;'
              : p.status === 'cargado'
              ? 'background: #FFFBEB; color: #B45309;'
              : 'background: #FEF2F2; color: #B91C1C;'
          }">
            ${escapeHtml(productStatusLabel(p).toUpperCase())}
          </span>
        </td>
        <td style="padding: 8px 6px; text-align: right; font-weight: bold; font-family: monospace;">${escapeHtml(productCitationLabel(p))}</td>
      </tr>
    `
      )
      .join('');

    const html = `
      <!DOCTYPE html>
      <html lang="es">
      <head>
        <meta charset="UTF-8">
        <title>Reporte de Producción Científica - SIMAPC</title>
        <style>
          @page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 12mm; }
          @font-face { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque'; src: url('${bricolageFontUrl}') format('woff2'); font-style: normal; font-weight: 200 800; }
          @font-face { font-family: 'Source Sans 3'; src: url('${sourceSansFontUrl}') format('woff2'); font-style: normal; font-weight: 200 900; }
          :root { --school-accent: ${schoolAccent}; --school-ink: color-mix(in srgb, var(--school-accent) 46%, #252321); }
          body { font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; color: #252321; margin: 0; padding: 20px; }
          h1, h2, h3 { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; color: #252321; }
          .header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--school-accent); padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; }
          .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
          .brand-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #252321; margin: 0; line-height: 1; }
          .brand-subtitle { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #4B5563; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 4px; }
          .meta-box { font-size: 10px; color: #6B7280; text-align: right; }
          table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 10px; }
          th { background-color: #F9FAFB; padding: 8px 6px; text-align: left; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #4B5563; border-bottom: 2px solid #E5E7EB; }
          .footer { margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid #E5E7EB; font-size: 9px; color: #9CA3AF; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
        </style>
      </head>
      <body>
        <div class="header">
          <div class="brand">
            <div>
              <div class="brand-title">SIMAPC</div>
              <div class="brand-subtitle">${escapeHtml(meta.school)} · Universidad Yachay Tech</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="meta-box">
            <div><strong>${products.some(product => product.bibliographicSource) ? 'Reporte de Producción Científica · Importación ORCID' : 'Reporte Oficial de Producción Científica'}</strong></div>
            <div>Fecha: ${meta.generatedAt}</div>
            <div>Total Registros: ${meta.totalRecords}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th style="width: 70px;">ID</th>
              <th style="width: 85px;">Tipo</th>
              <th>Título y Autores</th>
              <th style="width: 170px;">Línea de Investigación</th>
              <th style="width: 65px; text-align: center;">Periodo</th>
              <th style="width: 130px;">Identificador</th>
              <th style="width: 85px; text-align: center;">Estado</th>
              <th style="width: 50px; text-align: right;">Citas</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            ${tableRowsHtml}
          </tbody>
        </table>

        <div class="footer">
          <div>Universidad de Investigación de Tecnología Experimental Yachay Tech • San Miguel de Urcuquí, Imbabura, Ecuador</div>
          <div>Reporte generado desde SIMAPC${products.some(product => product.bibliographicSource) ? ' · El archivo contiene investigadores vinculados por ORCID; no incluye la autoría completa.' : ''}</div>
        </div>
      </body>
      </html>
    `;

    return openPrintableDocument(html);
  },

  async exportTeacherCv(teacher: TeacherUser, products: ScientificProduct[], metrics: TeacherMetrics, generatedAt: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const schoolAccent = SCHOOLS.find(school => teacher.school === school.code)?.accent ?? '#252321';
    const importedProfile = teacher.id.startsWith('ecmc-orcid-researcher-');

    const profileLink = (field: 'githubUrl' | 'googleScholarId' | 'scopusAuthorId' | 'webOfScienceId', label: string, href: string, identifier: string) => {
      if (!identifier) return '';
      if (teacher.syntheticAcademicProfileFields?.includes(field)) return `<span>${label}</span>`;
      return `<a href="${escapeHtml(href)}">${label} · ${escapeHtml(identifier)}</a>`;
    };
    const links = [
      teacher.orcid && `<a href="https://orcid.org/${escapeHtml(teacher.orcid)}">ORCID · ${escapeHtml(teacher.orcid)}</a>`,
      teacher.googleScholarId && profileLink('googleScholarId', 'Google Scholar', `https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=${encodeURIComponent(teacher.googleScholarId)}`, teacher.googleScholarId),
      teacher.scopusAuthorId && profileLink('scopusAuthorId', 'Scopus', `https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=${encodeURIComponent(teacher.scopusAuthorId)}`, teacher.scopusAuthorId),
      teacher.webOfScienceId && profileLink('webOfScienceId', 'Web of Science', `https://www.webofscience.com/wos/author/record/${encodeURIComponent(teacher.webOfScienceId)}`, teacher.webOfScienceId),
      teacher.githubUrl && profileLink('githubUrl', 'GitHub', teacher.githubUrl, teacher.githubUrl),
    ].filter(Boolean).join(' <span>·</span> ');
    const researchLines = teacher.researchLines?.length
      ? teacher.researchLines
      : teacher.researchLine ? [teacher.researchLine] : [];
    const researchAreasHtml = researchLines.length
      ? researchLines.map(line => `<p><strong>${escapeHtml(line)}</strong>${teacher.researchSublines?.[line]?.length ? `<br>${teacher.researchSublines[line]?.map(escapeHtml).join(' · ')}` : ''}</p>`).join('')
      : '<p>No registradas</p>';
    const externalIndex = (name: string, value?: number) => {
      const shownValue = value === undefined ? 'No disponible' : String(value);
      return `<p><strong>Índice h ${name}:</strong> ${shownValue}</p>`;
    };
    const productsHtml = products.length
      ? products.map((product) => `<article class="product">
          <div class="product-meta">${product.type === 'publicacion' ? 'Publicación científica' : 'Proyecto de investigación'} · ${escapeHtml(product.year)}${product.projectStatus ? ` · ${escapeHtml(PROJECT_STATUS_LABELS[product.projectStatus])}` : ''}</div>
          <h3>${escapeHtml(product.title)}</h3>
          <p class="authors">${escapeHtml((product.projectParticipants?.length ? product.projectParticipants : product.authors).join(' · '))}</p>
          <p>${escapeHtml(product.venue || product.fundingVenue || product.researchLine)}${product.volumeIssue ? ` · ${escapeHtml(product.volumeIssue)}` : ''}</p>
          <p class="product-meta">${escapeHtml(productDateValue(product))}${doiForDisplay(product) ? ` · DOI: ${escapeHtml(doiForDisplay(product)!)}` : product.projectCode ? ` · Código: ${escapeHtml(product.projectCode)}` : ''}</p>
          ${product.type === 'proyecto' && product.expectedProducts?.length ? `<p><strong>Productos esperados:</strong> ${escapeHtml(product.expectedProducts.join(' · '))}</p>` : ''}
        </article>`).join('')
      : '<p>No hay producción verificada registrada en el portal.</p>';

    const html = `<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="es"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>CV · ${escapeHtml(teacher.name)}</title>
      <style>
        @font-face{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';src:url('${bricolageFontUrl}') format('woff2');font-style:normal;font-weight:200 800}
        @font-face{font-family:'Source Sans 3';src:url('${sourceSansFontUrl}') format('woff2');font-style:normal;font-weight:200 900}
        :root{--school-accent:${schoolAccent};--school-ink:color-mix(in srgb,var(--school-accent) 46%,#252321)}
        @page{size:A4;margin:18mm}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{font-family:'Source Sans 3',sans-serif;color:#252321;line-height:1.45;margin:0;font-size:10.5pt}
        h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;color:#252321}
        header{border-bottom:1px solid var(--school-accent);padding-bottom:14px;margin-bottom:22px}h1{font-size:25pt;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 5px}header p{margin:3px 0;color:#645d56}
        .eyebrow{font-size:9pt;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:1.4px;color:var(--school-ink);margin:0 0 6px}
        h2{font-size:13pt;letter-spacing:-.015em;border-bottom:1px solid #ded7ce;padding-bottom:5px;margin:19px 0 8px}
        h3{font-size:11pt;margin:3px 0}.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px 24px}.facts p{margin:2px 0}.muted,.product-meta{color:#6a625b;font-size:9pt}.links{font-size:9pt}.links a{color:#8b2a23;text-decoration:none}.product{padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e5dfd8;break-inside:avoid}.product p{margin:2px 0}.authors{font-weight:600}.bio{white-space:pre-wrap}.footer{margin-top:24px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid #ded7ce;color:#777;font-size:8pt;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
        @media print{a{color:inherit}}
      </style></head><body>
      <header><p class="eyebrow">${importedProfile ? 'Perfil bibliográfico' : 'Currículum académico'} · SIMAPC</p><h1>${escapeHtml(teacher.name)}</h1>
        ${teacher.rank || teacher.academicDegree ? `<p>${escapeHtml(teacher.rank)}${teacher.academicDegree ? ` · ${escapeHtml(teacher.academicDegree)}${teacher.academicField ? ` en ${escapeHtml(teacher.academicField)}` : ''}` : ''}</p>` : ''}
        <p>${importedProfile ? 'Fuente: emcc_orcid.sql' : `${escapeHtml(teacher.email)} · Universidad Yachay Tech${teacher.yachayEntryYear ? ` · Docente desde ${escapeHtml(teacher.yachayEntryYear)}` : ''}`}</p></header>
      ${importedProfile ? '<p class="muted">El archivo no incluye formación, afiliación ni autoría completa. Los investigadores vinculados corresponden a las asociaciones ORCID de la fuente.</p>' : ''}
      <section><h2>Perfil profesional</h2><p class="bio">${escapeHtml(teacher.bio || (importedProfile ? 'No consta en el archivo importado.' : 'Perfil académico del personal investigador de la Universidad Yachay Tech.'))}</p></section>
      <section><h2>Áreas de investigación</h2>${researchAreasHtml}</section>
      <section><h2>Indicadores de producción</h2><div class="facts"><p><strong>Publicaciones verificadas:</strong> ${metrics.publicationsCount}</p><p><strong>Proyectos verificados:</strong> ${metrics.projectsCount}</p><p><strong>Citas registradas:</strong> ${metrics.citationsTotal}</p>${externalIndex('Google Scholar', teacher.googleScholarHIndex)}${externalIndex('Scopus', teacher.scopusHIndex)}</div></section>
      <section><h2>Identificadores y perfiles académicos</h2><p class="links">${links || 'No registrados'}</p></section>
      <section><h2>Producción académica verificada (${products.length})</h2>${productsHtml}</section>
      <div class="footer"><span>Universidad Yachay Tech · SIMAPC</span><span>Generado ${escapeHtml(generatedAt)}</span></div>
      </body></html>`;

    return openPrintableDocument(html);
  },
};


===== src\services\metricsService.ts =====

import { ScientificProduct, TeacherUser, TeacherMetrics, SchoolMetrics, AcademicSemester } from '../types';
import { ACADEMIC_SEMESTERS } from '../constants/researchLines';
import { storageService } from './storage';
import { productCitationValue, productMatchesTeacher } from './productPresentation';

export interface TemporalDataPoint {
  semester: string;
  unit?: 'year' | 'semester';
  publications: number;
  projects: number;
  total: number;
}

const academicSemesterSet = new Set<AcademicSemester>(ACADEMIC_SEMESTERS);

function semesterForProduct(product: ScientificProduct): AcademicSemester | undefined {
  if (product.semester && academicSemesterSet.has(product.semester)) return product.semester;

  // Los registros recientes guardan una fecha precisa en vez del semestre antiguo.
  const productDate = product.type === 'publicacion'
    ? product.publicationDate
    : product.projectStartDate;
  const dateParts = productDate?.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})/);
  if (!dateParts) return undefined;

  const year = Number(dateParts[1]);
  const month = Number(dateParts[2]);
  if (month < 1 || month > 12) return undefined;

  const semester = `${year}-${month <= 6 ? 1 : 2}` as AcademicSemester;
  return academicSemesterSet.has(semester) ? semester : undefined;
}

export const metricsService = {
  /**
   * Calcula las métricas institucionales de la Escuela de Ciencias Matemáticas y Computacionales (ECMC)
   * Los productos en coautoría cuentan UNA sola vez para el total institucional.
   */
  calculateSchoolMetrics(products: ScientificProduct[]): SchoolMetrics {
    // Para indicadores institucionales oficiales, tomamos los productos verificados
    // (siguiendo la política de visualización y trazabilidad)
    const verifiedProducts = products.filter((p) => p.status === 'verificado');
    const publications = verifiedProducts.filter((p) => p.type === 'publicacion');
    const projects = verifiedProducts.filter((p) => p.type === 'proyecto');

    const totalCitations = publications.reduce((acc, p) => acc + (productCitationValue(p) ?? 0), 0);

    return {
      totalPublications: publications.length,
      totalProjects: projects.length,
      totalCitations,
      researchLinesWithProduction: new Set(verifiedProducts.map((product) => product.researchLine).filter(Boolean)).size,
    };
  },

  /**
   * Calcula las métricas individuales para cada docente
   */
  calculateTeacherMetrics(teacher: TeacherUser, allProducts: ScientificProduct[]): TeacherMetrics {
    // Las métricas de perfiles públicos se calculan solo con productos verificados.
    const verifiedProducts = allProducts.filter((p) => p.status === 'verificado');
    const teacherProducts = verifiedProducts.filter(product => productMatchesTeacher(product, teacher));

    const publications = teacherProducts.filter((p) => p.type === 'publicacion');
    const projects = teacherProducts.filter((p) => p.type === 'proyecto');

    // Citas acumuladas en publicaciones
    const citationsTotal = publications.reduce((acc, p) => acc + (productCitationValue(p) ?? 0), 0);
    return {
      teacher,
      publicationsCount: publications.length,
      projectsCount: projects.length,
      citationsTotal,
    };
  },

  /**
   * Obtiene la tabla completa de métricas para todos los docentes registrados
   */
  getAllTeacherMetrics(): TeacherMetrics[] {
    const teachers = storageService.getTeachers();
    const products = storageService.getProducts();

    return teachers.map((teacher) => this.calculateTeacherMetrics(teacher, products));
  },

  /**
   * Genera los puntos de la serie temporal por semestre (2021-1 a 2026-2)
   * Los semestres sin producción registran explícitamente 0
   */
  getTemporalEvolutionData(products: ScientificProduct[]): TemporalDataPoint[] {
    if (products.some(product => product.school === 'ECMC' && product.bibliographicSource)) {
      const verified = products.filter(product => product.status === 'verificado');
      const years = verified.map(product => product.year).filter(year => Number.isInteger(year) && year > 0);
      if (!years.length) return [];
      // The imported source records a year, not a semester or publication day.
      // An annual series keeps every record without inventing either value.
      const firstYear = Math.min(...years);
      const lastYear = Math.max(...years);
      return Array.from({ length: lastYear - firstYear + 1 }, (_, index) => {
        const year = firstYear + index;
        const yearProducts = verified.filter(product => product.year === year);
        const publications = yearProducts.filter(product => product.type === 'publicacion').length;
        const projects = yearProducts.filter(product => product.type === 'proyecto').length;
        return { semester: String(year), unit: 'year' as const, publications, projects, total: publications + projects };
      });
    }
    const counts = new Map<AcademicSemester, { publications: number; projects: number }>(
      ACADEMIC_SEMESTERS.map((semester) => [semester, { publications: 0, projects: 0 }])
    );

    products.forEach((product) => {
      if (product.status !== 'verificado') return;
      const semester = semesterForProduct(product);
      if (!semester) return;

      const count = counts.get(semester)!;
      if (product.type === 'publicacion') count.publications += 1;
      else if (product.type === 'proyecto') count.projects += 1;
    });

    return ACADEMIC_SEMESTERS.map((semester) => {
      const { publications: pubCount, projects: projCount } = counts.get(semester)!;

      return {
        semester,
        publications: pubCount,
        projects: projCount,
        total: pubCount + projCount,
      };
    });
  },
};


===== src\services\pdfExtractorService.ts =====

import { OfficialResearchLine, AcademicSemester } from '../types';

export interface ExtractedPdfProjectMetadata {
  simulated: boolean;
  title: string;
  projectCode?: string;
  director?: string;
  participants: string[];
  year: number;
  semester: AcademicSemester;
  researchLine: OfficialResearchLine;
  abstract: string;
  fundingVenue?: string;
  fileName: string;
  fileSizeBytes: number;
}

const MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10 MB

export const pdfExtractorService = {
  /**
   * Valida tipo, tamaño e integridad básica del archivo
   */
  validateFile(file: File): { valid: boolean; error?: string } {
    if (!file) {
      return { valid: false, error: 'No se seleccionó ningún archivo.' };
    }

    const isPdfType = file.type === 'application/pdf' || file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf');
    if (!isPdfType) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        error: 'El archivo seleccionado no es un documento PDF válido. Por favor sube un archivo con extensión .pdf.',
      };
    }

    if (file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES) {
      const sizeMb = (file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2);
      return {
        valid: false,
        error: `El archivo excede el tamaño máximo permitido de 10 MB (tamaño actual: ${sizeMb} MB).`,
      };
    }

    if (file.size === 0) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        error: 'El archivo está vacío o dañado (0 bytes). Por favor verifica el documento original.',
      };
    }

    return { valid: true };
  },

  /**
   * Simula metadatos preliminares tras validar el PDF; no es un parser real.
   */
  async extractProjectMetadata(file: File): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    data?: ExtractedPdfProjectMetadata;
    error?: string;
    warning?: string;
  }> {
    const validation = this.validateFile(file);
    if (!validation.valid) {
      return { success: false, error: validation.error };
    }

    // Leemos el texto crudo del archivo para detectar encabezados y metadatos básicos
    try {
      const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      // Verificación de firma mágica PDF (%PDF-)
      const headerBytes = new Uint8Array(arrayBuffer.slice(0, 5));
      const headerString = String.fromCharCode(...headerBytes);
      if (!headerString.startsWith('%PDF')) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'El archivo está dañado o no posee la estructura estándar de formato PDF (%PDF).',
        };
      }

      // Decodificación de texto representativo del PDF
      const textDecoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: false });
      const rawText = textDecoder.decode(arrayBuffer);

      // Limpieza del nombre de archivo para inferir datos si el PDF está escaneado
      const baseName = file.name.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '').replace(/[_-]/g, ' ');

      // Detección de año y semestre
      const yearMatch = rawText.match(/\b(202[1-6])\b/);
      const detectedYear = yearMatch ? parseInt(yearMatch[1], 10) : new Date().getFullYear();
      const detectedSemester: AcademicSemester = `${detectedYear}-1` as AcademicSemester;

      // Inferencia de título
      const title = baseName.length > 5
        ? `Proyecto: ${baseName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + baseName.slice(1)}`
        : 'Proyecto de Investigación ECMC';

      return {
        success: true,
        data: {
          simulated: true,
          title,
          // La simulación no identifica estos datos; debe completarlos el usuario.
          projectCode: '',
          director: '',
          participants: [],
          year: detectedYear,
          semester: detectedSemester,
          researchLine: 'Computación científica',
          abstract: 'Resumen extraído del documento del proyecto para validación institucional por el cuerpo docente de la ECMC.',
          fundingVenue: 'Convocatoria Interna de Investigación Yachay Tech',
          fileName: file.name,
          fileSizeBytes: file.size,
        },
        warning: 'Metadatos preliminares extraídos. Por favor revisa y corrige cada campo antes de confirmar el guardado.',
      };
    } catch {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'No se pudo leer el archivo PDF. Si es un documento escaneado como imagen, utiliza la captura manual.',
      };
    }
  },
};


===== src\services\printDocument.ts =====

/** Keep the browser's blocking print dialog out of the portal's browsing context. */
export function openPrintableDocument(html: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let channel: BroadcastChannel | undefined;
    let objectUrl: string | undefined;
    let timeout: number | undefined;
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (success: boolean) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      window.clearTimeout(timeout);
      channel?.close();
      if (objectUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
      resolve(success);
    };

    try {
      const channelName = `simapc-print-${crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(4)).join('-')}`;
      channel = new BroadcastChannel(channelName);
      channel.onmessage = (event) => {
        if (event.data === 'opened') finish(true);
      };

      // A Blob document needs an explicit base to load the same local fonts on GitHub Pages.
      const baseUrl = document.baseURI.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => ({
        '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;',
      })[character]!);
      const printScript = `<script>
        const channel = new BroadcastChannel(${JSON.stringify(channelName)});
        channel.postMessage('opened');
        channel.close();
        window.addEventListener('load', async () => {
          await document.fonts.ready;
          window.focus();
          window.print();
        }, { once: true });
      </script>`;
      const documentHtml = html
        .replace('<head>', `<head><base href="${baseUrl}">`)
        .replace('</body>', `${printScript}</body>`);
      objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([documentHtml], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' }));
      timeout = window.setTimeout(() => finish(false), 10_000);

      // noopener puts printing in an independent context. Its readiness message also
      // distinguishes a successfully opened report from a browser-blocked popup.
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = objectUrl;
      link.target = '_blank';
      link.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      try {
        link.click();
      } finally {
        link.remove();
      }
    } catch {
      finish(false);
    }
  });
}


===== src\services\productPresentation.ts =====

import { ScientificProduct, TeacherUser, PRODUCT_STATUS_LABELS } from '../types';

export function productStatusLabel(product: ScientificProduct): string {
  return product.bibliographicSource && !product.verifiedAt && product.status === 'verificado'
    ? 'Importado (ORCID)'
    : PRODUCT_STATUS_LABELS[product.status];
}

export function productCitationValue(product: ScientificProduct): number | null {
  return product.bibliographicSource ? product.bibliographicSource.citations : product.citations;
}

export function productCitationLabel(product: ScientificProduct): string {
  const citations = productCitationValue(product);
  return citations === null ? 'No disponible' : String(citations);
}

const normalizedName = (name: string) => name.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
  .toLowerCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

export function productMatchesTeacher(product: ScientificProduct, teacher: TeacherUser): boolean {
  if (product.ownerId === teacher.id || product.authorIds?.includes(teacher.id)) return true;
  // An ORCID source supplies explicit researcher associations. Do not infer an
  // additional association from a similar or abbreviated author display name.
  if (product.authorIds) return false;
  const name = normalizedName(teacher.name);
  return !!name && product.authors.some(author => normalizedName(author) === name);
}

export function productDateLabel(product: ScientificProduct): string {
  const date = product.type === 'publicacion' ? product.publicationDate : product.projectStartDate;
  if (!date) return String(product.year);

  const parsed = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00`);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())
    ? String(product.year)
    : parsed.toLocaleDateString('es-EC', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
}

export function productDateValue(product: ScientificProduct): string {
  return product.type === 'publicacion'
    ? product.publicationDate || String(product.year)
    : product.projectStartDate || String(product.year);
}


===== src\services\productService.ts =====

import { authService } from './authService';
import { ScientificProduct, ProductStatus, FilterState, UserNotification, ProjectProgressReport, ProjectClosureReport } from '../types';
import { storageService, STORAGE_KEYS, withStorageRollback } from './storage';
import { normalizeDoi, normalizeProjectCode } from './doiService';
import { canReview } from '../constants/demoAccounts';
import { productMatchesTeacher } from './productPresentation';

export interface DuplicateCheckResult {
  hasDuplicate: boolean;
  message?: string;
  existingProduct?: ScientificProduct;
  warning?: string;
}

const validIsoDate = (value: string) => {
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(value);
  if (!match) return false;
  const [, year, month, day] = match.map(Number);
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  return date.getUTCFullYear() === year && date.getUTCMonth() === month - 1 && date.getUTCDate() === day;
};

const cleanList = (values: string[]) => values.map(value => value.trim()).filter(Boolean);

function normalizeAuthorName(name: string): string {
  return name.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

function todayLocalIso(): string {
  const today = new Date();
  return `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

const SAVE_ERROR = 'No se pudieron guardar los cambios en este dispositivo. Revise el espacio disponible e inténtelo de nuevo.';
type SaveResult = { success: boolean; error?: string };

function saveProductWithNotification(products: ScientificProduct[], notification: Omit<UserNotification, 'id' | 'read' | 'createdAt'>): SaveResult {
  const saved = withStorageRollback([STORAGE_KEYS.PRODUCTS, STORAGE_KEYS.NOTIFICATIONS], () => {
    if (!storageService.saveProducts(products)) return false;
    return productService.createNotification(notification).success;
  });
  return saved ? { success: true } : { success: false, error: SAVE_ERROR };
}

export const productService = {
  /**
   * Obtiene todos los productos almacenados
   */
  getAllProducts(): ScientificProduct[] {
    return storageService.getProducts();
  },

  /**
   * Obtiene productos visibles según el usuario actual y la política pública
   * Si es visitante: solo productos 'verificado' (por defecto)
   * Si es profesor: ve todos sus propios productos + productos verificados de otros
   */
  getVisibleProducts(currentUserId: string | null): ScientificProduct[] {
    const all = storageService.getProducts();

    if (!currentUserId) {
      return all.filter((p) => p.status === 'verificado');
    }

    const actor = authService.getCurrentUser();
    if (!actor || actor.id !== currentUserId) {
      return all.filter((p) => p.status === 'verificado');
    }

    return all.filter((p) => {
      // El propietario conserva acceso a sus registros en cualquier estado.
      if (p.status === 'verificado') return true;
      if (p.ownerId === actor.id) return true;
      // Los proyectos no verificados quedan restringidos a docentes y al comité científico.
      return p.type === 'proyecto' && ['teacher', 'reviewer_demo', 'developer'].includes(actor.role);
    });
  },

  /**
   * Obtiene un producto por su identificador
   */
  getProductById(id: string): ScientificProduct | undefined {
    const products = storageService.getProducts();
    return products.find((p) => p.id === id);
  },

  /**
   * Valida la existencia de duplicados antes de agregar (HU07)
   */
  checkDuplicates(productData: Partial<ScientificProduct>, excludeId?: string): DuplicateCheckResult {
    const products = storageService.getProducts();
    const targetDoi = normalizeDoi(productData.doi);
    const targetCode = normalizeProjectCode(productData.projectCode);

    // 1. Verificación por DOI para publicaciones
    if (targetDoi) {
      const match = products.find((p) => {
        if (excludeId && p.id === excludeId) return false;
        return normalizeDoi(p.doi) === targetDoi;
      });

      if (match) {
        return {
          hasDuplicate: true,
          message: `Ya existe una publicación registrada con el DOI "${match.doi}". Producto existente: "${match.title}" (ID: ${match.id}).`,
          existingProduct: match,
        };
      }
    }

    // 2. Verificación por código de proyecto
    if (targetCode) {
      const match = products.find((p) => {
        if (excludeId && p.id === excludeId) return false;
        return normalizeProjectCode(p.projectCode) === targetCode;
      });

      if (match) {
        return {
          hasDuplicate: true,
          message: `Ya existe un proyecto registrado con el código "${match.projectCode}". Producto existente: "${match.title}" (ID: ${match.id}).`,
          existingProduct: match,
        };
      }
    }

    // 3. Si no tiene ni DOI ni código
    if (!targetDoi && !targetCode) {
      return {
        hasDuplicate: false,
        warning: 'No fue posible verificar la existencia mediante identificador. El producto se registrará para verificación del Comité Científico.',
      };
    }

    return { hasDuplicate: false };
  },

  /**
   * Registra un nuevo producto con estado inicial obligatorio "cargado" (HU03)
   */
  createProduct(
    productData: Omit<ScientificProduct, 'id' | 'status' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt' | 'citations' | 'ownerId'>,
    ownerId: string
  ): { success: boolean; product?: ScientificProduct; error?: string; warning?: string } {
    const actor=authService.getCurrentUser();
    if (!actor || !['teacher', 'developer'].includes(actor.role) || actor.id!==ownerId) return {success:false,error:'Su perfil no permite registrar publicaciones ni proyectos.'};
    const dupCheck = this.checkDuplicates(productData);
    if (dupCheck.hasDuplicate) {
      return { success: false, error: dupCheck.message };
    }

    const products = [...storageService.getProducts()];
    const newId = `prod-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const newProduct: ScientificProduct = {
      ...productData,
      id: newId,
      ownerId,
      school: productData.school || 'ECMC',
      status: 'cargado', // Estado oficial inicial
      citations: 0,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };

    products.unshift(newProduct);
    // Generar notificación al propietario (HU08 / CA22)
    const saved = saveProductWithNotification(products, {
      userId: ownerId,
      productId: newId,
      productTitle: newProduct.title,
      status: 'cargado',
      message: `Tu ${newProduct.type === 'publicacion' ? 'publicación científica' : 'proyecto de investigación'} "${newProduct.title}" ha sido cargado exitosamente. Estado: cargado.`,
    });
    if (!saved.success) return saved;

    return {
      success: true,
      product: newProduct,
      warning: dupCheck.warning,
    };
  },

  /** Permite al responsable corregir y volver a enviar un producto observado. */
  updateObservedProduct(
    productId: string,
    productData: Omit<ScientificProduct, 'id' | 'status' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt' | 'citations' | 'ownerId'>
  ): { success: boolean; product?: ScientificProduct; error?: string; warning?: string } {
    const actor = authService.getCurrentUser();
    if (!actor || actor.role !== 'teacher') return { success: false, error: 'Inicia sesión con un perfil docente para corregir el producto.' };

    const products = [...storageService.getProducts()];
    const index = products.findIndex(product => product.id === productId);
    if (index < 0) return { success: false, error: 'No se encontró el producto.' };

    const existing = products[index];
    if (existing.ownerId !== actor.id) return { success: false, error: 'Solo el docente responsable puede editar este producto.' };
    if (existing.status !== 'rechazado') return { success: false, error: 'Solo se pueden editar productos que estén en observación.' };

    const duplicate = this.checkDuplicates(productData, productId);
    if (duplicate.hasDuplicate) return { success: false, error: duplicate.message };

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const updated: ScientificProduct = {
      ...existing,
      ...productData,
      id: existing.id,
      ownerId: existing.ownerId,
      school: existing.school,
      citations: existing.citations,
      articleAttachment: productData.articleAttachment || existing.articleAttachment,
      status: 'cargado',
      rejectionReason: undefined,
      verifiedAt: undefined,
      createdAt: existing.createdAt,
      updatedAt: now,
    };

    products[index] = updated;
    const saved = saveProductWithNotification(products, {
      userId: actor.id,
      productId: updated.id,
      productTitle: updated.title,
      status: 'cargado',
      message: `Se corrigió y volvió a enviar "${updated.title}" al Comité Científico para verificación.`,
    });
    if (!saved.success) return saved;

    return { success: true, product: updated, warning: duplicate.warning };
  },

  addProjectProgressReport(
    productId: string,
    reportData: Omit<ProjectProgressReport, 'id' | 'reportedAt' | 'isSynthetic'>
  ): { success: boolean; product?: ScientificProduct; error?: string } {
    const actor = authService.getCurrentUser();
    if (!actor || actor.role !== 'teacher') return { success: false, error: 'Inicia sesión con un perfil docente para registrar avances.' };

    const products = [...storageService.getProducts()];
    const index = products.findIndex(product => product.id === productId);
    if (index < 0) return { success: false, error: 'No se encontró el proyecto.' };
    const product = products[index];
    if (product.type !== 'proyecto') return { success: false, error: 'El seguimiento solo está disponible para proyectos.' };
    if (product.ownerId !== actor.id) return { success: false, error: 'Solo el docente responsable puede registrar avances.' };
    if (product.projectStatus === 'finalizado' || product.projectStatus === 'cancelado') return { success: false, error: 'El proyecto ya tiene un informe de cierre y no admite nuevos avances.' };
    if (!validIsoDate(reportData.periodStart) || !validIsoDate(reportData.periodEnd) || reportData.periodStart > reportData.periodEnd || reportData.periodEnd > todayLocalIso()) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Revise las fechas del periodo informado.' };
    }
    if (!Number.isInteger(reportData.progressPercent) || reportData.progressPercent < 0 || reportData.progressPercent > 100) {
      return { success: false, error: 'El avance debe ser un porcentaje entre 0 y 100.' };
    }
    if (reportData.summary.trim().length < 20) return { success: false, error: 'Describa el avance con al menos 20 caracteres.' };
    if (reportData.nextSteps.trim().length < 8) return { success: false, error: 'Indique los próximos pasos.' };
    const completedActivities = cleanList(reportData.completedActivities);
    if (!completedActivities.length) return { success: false, error: 'Añada al menos una actividad realizada.' };

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const report: ProjectProgressReport = {
      ...reportData,
      id: `avance-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
      summary: reportData.summary.trim(),
      completedActivities,
      achievedProducts: cleanList(reportData.achievedProducts),
      blockers: reportData.blockers?.trim() || undefined,
      nextSteps: reportData.nextSteps.trim(),
      reportedAt: now,
    };
    const updated: ScientificProduct = {
      ...product,
      projectStatus: report.statusAfterReport,
      projectProgressReports: [...(product.projectProgressReports || []), report],
      updatedAt: now,
    };
    products[index] = updated;
    const saved = saveProductWithNotification(products, {
      userId: actor.id,
      productId: updated.id,
      productTitle: updated.title,
      status: updated.status,
      message: `Se guardó el informe de avance de "${updated.title}" (${report.progressPercent}%).`,
    });
    if (!saved.success) return saved;
    return { success: true, product: updated };
  },

  closeProject(
    productId: string,
    closureData: Omit<ProjectClosureReport, 'id' | 'isSynthetic'>
  ): { success: boolean; product?: ScientificProduct; error?: string } {
    const actor = authService.getCurrentUser();
    if (!actor || actor.role !== 'teacher') return { success: false, error: 'Inicia sesión con un perfil docente para cerrar el proyecto.' };

    const products = [...storageService.getProducts()];
    const index = products.findIndex(product => product.id === productId);
    if (index < 0) return { success: false, error: 'No se encontró el proyecto.' };
    const product = products[index];
    if (product.type !== 'proyecto') return { success: false, error: 'El cierre solo está disponible para proyectos.' };
    if (product.ownerId !== actor.id) return { success: false, error: 'Solo el docente responsable puede cerrar este proyecto.' };
    if (product.projectClosureReport) {
      return { success: false, error: 'El proyecto ya cuenta con un informe de cierre.' };
    }
    if (!validIsoDate(closureData.closedAt) || closureData.closedAt > todayLocalIso()) return { success: false, error: 'Indique una fecha de cierre válida.' };
    if (closureData.summary.trim().length < 30) return { success: false, error: 'El resumen de cierre debe tener al menos 30 caracteres.' };
    const deliveredProducts = cleanList(closureData.deliveredProducts);
    if (closureData.finalStatus === 'finalizado' && !deliveredProducts.length) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Registre al menos un producto o resultado entregado para finalizar el proyecto.' };
    }

    const closure: ProjectClosureReport = {
      ...closureData,
      id: `cierre-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
      summary: closureData.summary.trim(),
      deliveredProducts,
      pendingItems: cleanList(closureData.pendingItems),
      lessonsLearned: closureData.lessonsLearned?.trim() || undefined,
    };
    const updated: ScientificProduct = {
      ...product,
      projectStatus: closure.finalStatus,
      projectClosureReport: closure,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    products[index] = updated;
    const saved = saveProductWithNotification(products, {
      userId: actor.id,
      productId: updated.id,
      productTitle: updated.title,
      status: updated.status,
      message: `Se registró el cierre del proyecto "${updated.title}" como ${closure.finalStatus === 'finalizado' ? 'finalizado' : 'cancelado'}.`,
    });
    if (!saved.success) return saved;
    return { success: true, product: updated };
  },

  /**
   * Transición de estado ejecutada por el Comité Revisor (Consola de Extensión Propuesta)
   * Estados oficiales: cargado -> verificado | rechazado
   */
  updateProductStatus(
    productId: string,
    newStatus: ProductStatus,
    rejectionReason?: string
  ): { success: boolean; product?: ScientificProduct; error?: string } {
    const actor = authService.getCurrentUser();
    if (!actor || !canReview(actor)) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Su perfil no permite revisar publicaciones ni proyectos.' };
    }
    if (newStatus === 'rechazado' && (!rejectionReason || !rejectionReason.trim())) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Indique qué información debe corregirse o completarse antes de verificar el producto.',
      };
    }

    const products = [...storageService.getProducts()];
    const index = products.findIndex((p) => p.id === productId);
    if (index === -1) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Producto no encontrado.' };
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const product = { ...products[index] };
    if (newStatus === 'verificado' && product.ownerId === actor.id) {
      return { success: false, error: 'No puede verificar un producto propio.' };
    }
    const prevStatus = product.status;

    // Solo emitir notificación si hubo transición efectiva (evitar duplicados)
    if (prevStatus === newStatus) {
      return { success: true, product };
    }

    product.status = newStatus;
    product.updatedAt = now;

    if (newStatus === 'verificado') {
      product.verifiedAt = now;
      product.rejectionReason = undefined;
    } else if (newStatus === 'rechazado') {
      product.rejectionReason = rejectionReason?.trim();
    }

    products[index] = product;
    // Notificación al autor (HU08 / CA23)
    const notifMessage =
      newStatus === 'verificado'
        ? `El Comité Científico ha verificado y certificado tu producto "${product.title}".`
        : `El Comité Científico dejó el producto "${product.title}" en observación. Información solicitada: ${product.rejectionReason}`;

    const saved = saveProductWithNotification(products, {
      userId: product.ownerId,
      productId: product.id,
      productTitle: product.title,
      status: newStatus,
      reason: product.rejectionReason,
      message: notifMessage,
    });
    if (!saved.success) return saved;

    return { success: true, product };
  },

  /**
   * Notificaciones para un usuario con control de duplicados
   */
  createNotification(data: Omit<UserNotification, 'id' | 'read' | 'createdAt'>): SaveResult {
    const notifs = [...storageService.getNotifications()];
    const newId = `notif-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`;

    const newNotif: UserNotification = {
      ...data,
      id: newId,
      read: false,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    notifs.unshift(newNotif);
    return storageService.saveNotifications(notifs) ? { success: true } : { success: false, error: SAVE_ERROR };
  },

  getUserNotifications(userId: string): UserNotification[] {
    const notifs = storageService.getNotifications();
    return notifs.filter((n) => n.userId === userId);
  },

  markNotificationAsRead(notifId: string): SaveResult {
    const notifs = storageService.getNotifications();
    const updated = notifs.map((n) => (n.id === notifId ? { ...n, read: true } : n));
    return storageService.saveNotifications(updated) ? { success: true } : { success: false, error: SAVE_ERROR };
  },

  markAllNotificationsAsRead(userId: string): SaveResult {
    const notifs = storageService.getNotifications();
    const updated = notifs.map((n) => (n.userId === userId ? { ...n, read: true } : n));
    return storageService.saveNotifications(updated) ? { success: true } : { success: false, error: SAVE_ERROR };
  },

  /**
   * Filtra productos combinando todos los criterios con intersección lógica (HU06)
   */
  filterProducts(products: ScientificProduct[], filters: FilterState): ScientificProduct[] {
    const query = filters.searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    const authorQuery = normalizeAuthorName(filters.searchQuery);

    return products.filter((p) => {
      // 1. Búsqueda de texto (título, autores, DOI, medio/venue, código)
      if (query) {
        const matchesTitle = p.title.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchesAuthor = !!authorQuery && p.authors.some((a) => normalizeAuthorName(a) === authorQuery);
        const matchesDoi = p.doi ? p.doi.toLowerCase().includes(query) : false;
        const matchesVenue = p.venue ? p.venue.toLowerCase().includes(query) : false;
        const matchesCode = p.projectCode ? p.projectCode.toLowerCase().includes(query) : false;
        if (!matchesTitle && !matchesAuthor && !matchesDoi && !matchesVenue && !matchesCode) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      // 2. Tipo de producto
      if (filters.productType !== 'todos' && p.type !== filters.productType) {
        return false;
      }

      // 3. Docente
      if (filters.teacherId !== 'todos') {
        const teachers = storageService.getTeachers();
        const teacher = teachers.find((t) => t.id === filters.teacherId);
        if (teacher) {
          // Coincidencia por ID de propietario o autor en la lista
          if (!productMatchesTeacher(p, teacher)) return false;
        }
      }

      // 4. Periodo / Año
      if (filters.periodYear !== 'todos') {
        const matchesYear = String(p.year) === filters.periodYear;
        const matchesSemester = p.semester === filters.periodYear;
        if (!matchesYear && !matchesSemester) return false;
      }

      // 5. Línea de investigación
      if (filters.researchLine !== 'todas' && p.researchLine !== filters.researchLine) {
        return false;
      }

      // 6. Estado de verificación
      if (filters.status !== 'todos' && p.status !== filters.status) {
        return false;
      }

      return true;
    });
  },
};


===== src\services\roleService.ts =====

import { TeacherUser } from '../types';
import { DEMO_ACCOUNTS } from '../constants/demoAccounts';
import { storageService } from './storage';
type Role = TeacherUser['role'];
const key = 'red_papers_roles_v1';
export const ROLE_LABELS: Record<Role,string> = {teacher:'Profesor', student:'Estudiante', reviewer_demo:'Comité Científico', developer:'Desarrollador'};
function assignments(): Record<string,Role> {
  try { const data=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)||'{}'); return data && typeof data==='object' && !Array.isArray(data)?data:{}; } catch { return {}; }
}
export function resolveRole(user: TeacherUser): TeacherUser {
  const stored = assignments()[user.id];
  const base = DEMO_ACCOUNTS.find(a=>a.user.id===user.id)?.user.role || 'teacher';
  return {...user, role:Object.hasOwn(ROLE_LABELS,stored) ? stored : base};
}
export const roleService = {
  users(): TeacherUser[] {
    const users = new Map(storageService.getTeachers().map(u=>[u.id,u]));
    DEMO_ACCOUNTS.filter(a=>a.user.role!=='student').forEach(a=>users.set(a.user.id,a.user));
    return [...users.values()].map(resolveRole);
  },
  assign(id:string, role:Role): {success:boolean; error?:string} {
    const session=storageService.getCurrentUser();
    const actor=session && resolveRole(session).role;
    if(!session || actor!=='developer') return {success:false,error:'No tiene permiso para asignar roles.'};
    if(!Object.hasOwn(ROLE_LABELS,role)) return {success:false,error:'Rol no válido.'};
    const users=this.users(), target=users.find(u=>u.id===id);
    if(!target) return {success:false,error:'Usuario no encontrado.'};
    if(target.role==='developer' || role==='developer') return {success:false,error:'Esta herramienta no modifica cuentas de desarrolladores.'};
    if(actor==='developer' && (role!=='reviewer_demo' && target.role!=='reviewer_demo')) return {success:false,error:'El desarrollador puede asignar o retirar miembros del comité.'};
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify({...assignments(),[id]:role}));
      if(session.id===id) storageService.setCurrentUser({...session,role});
      return {success:true};
    } catch { return {success:false,error:'No se pudo guardar el cambio. Inténtelo de nuevo.'}; }
  }
};



===== src\services\storage.ts =====

import { AcademicDegree, OfficialResearchLine, ScientificProduct, TeacherUser, UserNotification } from '../types';
import { INITIAL_PRODUCTS, INITIAL_TEACHERS, INITIAL_NOTIFICATIONS, LEGACY_ECMC_PRODUCT_IDS, LEGACY_ECMC_TEACHER_IDS } from '../constants/seedData';
import { INITIAL_SCHOOL_PRODUCTS, INITIAL_SCHOOL_TEACHERS } from '../constants/schoolSeedData';
import { ALL_OFFICIAL_RESEARCH_LINES } from '../constants/researchLines';


const INITIAL_TEACHER_DATA = [...INITIAL_TEACHERS, ...INITIAL_SCHOOL_TEACHERS];
const INITIAL_PRODUCT_DATA = [...INITIAL_PRODUCTS, ...INITIAL_SCHOOL_PRODUCTS];
const SEED_TEACHER_BY_ID = new Map(INITIAL_TEACHER_DATA.map((teacher) => [teacher.id, teacher]));

function completeSyntheticTeacher(teacher: TeacherUser): TeacherUser {
  if (teacher.id.startsWith('ecmc-orcid-researcher-')) return teacher;
  const defaults = SEED_TEACHER_BY_ID.get(teacher.id);
  if (!defaults || teacher.syntheticProfileSeedVersion) return teacher;

  let updated = teacher;
  const fillIfMissing = <K extends keyof TeacherUser>(key: K) => {
    if ((updated[key] === undefined || updated[key] === null) && defaults[key] !== undefined) {
      updated = { ...updated, [key]: defaults[key] };
    }
  };

  [
    'researchLines', 'researchSublines', 'githubUrl', 'googleScholarId', 'googleScholarHIndex',
    'scopusAuthorId', 'scopusHIndex', 'webOfScienceId',
  ].forEach((key) => fillIfMissing(key as keyof TeacherUser));

  const syntheticAcademicProfileFields = (defaults.syntheticAcademicProfileFields || [])
    .filter(field => updated[field] === defaults[field]);
  const syntheticBibliometricFields = (defaults.syntheticBibliometricFields || [])
    .filter(field => updated[field] === defaults[field]);

  return {
    ...updated,
    syntheticAcademicProfileFields,
    syntheticBibliometricFields,
    syntheticProfileSeedVersion: 1,
  };
}

export const STORAGE_KEYS = {
  PRODUCTS: 'red_papers_products_v1',
  TEACHERS: 'red_papers_teachers_v1',
  NOTIFICATIONS: 'red_papers_notifications_v1',
  CURRENT_USER: 'red_papers_current_user_v1',
  PUBLIC_VISIBILITY_CONFIG: 'red_papers_public_config_v1',
  ECMC_ORCID_IMPORT: 'red_papers_ecmc_orcid_import_v1',
  ECMC_LEGACY_BACKUP: 'red_papers_ecmc_pre_orcid_backup_v1',
};

/** Restore the original values if any part of a multi-key save fails. */
export function withStorageRollback(keys: readonly string[], save: () => boolean): boolean {
  let previous: Array<[string, string | null]> = [];
  try {
    previous = keys.map(key => [key, localStorage.getItem(key)]);
    if (save()) return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error guardando cambios en almacenamiento local:', err);
  }
  for (const [key, value] of previous.reverse()) {
    try {
      if (localStorage.getItem(key) === value) continue;
      if (value === null) localStorage.removeItem(key);
      else localStorage.setItem(key, value);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error revirtiendo el guardado local:', err);
    }
  }
  return false;
}

const ECMC_IMPORT_VERSION = 'emcc-orcid-2026-10-13-lines-v2';
interface ImportedStorage {
  products: ScientificProduct[];
  teachers: TeacherUser[];
  notifications: UserNotification[];
  currentUser: TeacherUser | null;
}

function readArray<T>(key: string, fallback: T[]): T[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
    if (raw === null) return fallback;
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(value) ? value : fallback;
  } catch { return fallback; }
}

const isLegacyEcmcTeacher = (teacher: TeacherUser) =>
  (!teacher.school || teacher.school === 'ECMC') && LEGACY_ECMC_TEACHER_IDS.has(teacher.id);
const isLegacyEcmcProduct = (product: ScientificProduct) =>
  (!product.school || product.school === 'ECMC') && LEGACY_ECMC_PRODUCT_IDS.has(product.id);
const importDoi = (doi?: string) => doi?.trim().replace(/^https?:\/\/(?:dx\.)?doi\.org\//i, '').toLowerCase();

/** Replace only the retired ECMC fixtures, once, without clearing users' storage. */
function importEcmcStorage(): ImportedStorage | undefined {
  try {
    if (localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.ECMC_ORCID_IMPORT) === ECMC_IMPORT_VERSION) return undefined;
    const previousProducts = readArray(STORAGE_KEYS.PRODUCTS, INITIAL_PRODUCT_DATA);
    const previousTeachers = readArray(STORAGE_KEYS.TEACHERS, INITIAL_TEACHER_DATA);
    const previousNotifications = readArray(STORAGE_KEYS.NOTIFICATIONS, INITIAL_NOTIFICATIONS);
    let currentUser: TeacherUser | null = null;
    try { currentUser = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CURRENT_USER) || 'null'); } catch { /* Invalid session. */ }

    const teachers = previousTeachers.filter(teacher => !isLegacyEcmcTeacher(teacher));
    const researcherIds = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const source of INITIAL_TEACHERS) {
      const existing = teachers.find(teacher => teacher.school === 'ECMC'
        && (teacher.id === source.id || (!!source.orcid && teacher.orcid === source.orcid)));
      researcherIds.set(source.id, existing?.id || source.id);
      if (!existing) teachers.push(source);
    }

    const products = previousProducts.filter(product => !isLegacyEcmcProduct(product));
    const existingIds = new Set(products.map(product => product.id));
    const existingDois = new Set(products.filter(product => product.school === 'ECMC').map(product => importDoi(product.doi)).filter(Boolean));
    for (const source of INITIAL_PRODUCTS) {
      const doi = importDoi(source.doi);
      const existingIndex = products.findIndex(product => product.id === source.id);
      if (existingIndex >= 0) {
        const existing = products[existingIndex];
        const previousClassification = existing.bibliographicSource?.researchLineClassification;
        if (previousClassification && existing.bibliographicSource) {
          // Refresh an older automated suggestion when the dictionary changes.
          const bibliographicSource = { ...existing.bibliographicSource };
          if (source.bibliographicSource?.researchLineClassification) {
            bibliographicSource.researchLineClassification = source.bibliographicSource.researchLineClassification;
          } else {
            delete bibliographicSource.researchLineClassification;
          }
          products[existingIndex] = { ...existing, researchLine: source.researchLine, bibliographicSource };
        // Fill only an empty line on an imported record; preserve manual assignments.
        } else if (!existing.researchLine && source.researchLine && existing.bibliographicSource) {
          products[existingIndex] = {
            ...existing,
            researchLine: source.researchLine,
            bibliographicSource: {
              ...existing.bibliographicSource,
              researchLineClassification: source.bibliographicSource?.researchLineClassification,
            },
          };
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (doi && existingDois.has(doi)) continue;
      products.push({ ...source, authorIds: source.authorIds?.map(id => researcherIds.get(id) || id) });
      existingIds.add(source.id);
      if (doi) existingDois.add(doi);
    }
    const notifications = previousNotifications.filter(notification => !LEGACY_ECMC_PRODUCT_IDS.has(notification.productId));
    const previousSession = currentUser;
    if (currentUser && isLegacyEcmcTeacher(currentUser)) {
      // Keep the public testing account separate from every real researcher.
      currentUser = currentUser.id === 'doc-001' ? {
        id: 'doc-001', name: 'Profesor de prueba', email: 'profesor@yachaytech.edu.ec',
        rank: 'Profesor', school: 'ECMC', role: 'teacher', createdAt: currentUser.createdAt,
      } : null;
    }

    const snapshot = { products, teachers, notifications, currentUser };
    const keys = [STORAGE_KEYS.PRODUCTS, STORAGE_KEYS.TEACHERS, STORAGE_KEYS.NOTIFICATIONS,
      STORAGE_KEYS.CURRENT_USER, STORAGE_KEYS.ECMC_ORCID_IMPORT, STORAGE_KEYS.ECMC_LEGACY_BACKUP];
    withStorageRollback(keys, () => {
      const removedProducts = previousProducts.filter(isLegacyEcmcProduct);
      const removedTeachers = previousTeachers.filter(isLegacyEcmcTeacher);
      const removedNotifications = previousNotifications.filter(notification => LEGACY_ECMC_PRODUCT_IDS.has(notification.productId));
      if ((removedProducts.length || removedTeachers.length || removedNotifications.length)
        && !localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.ECMC_LEGACY_BACKUP)) {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.ECMC_LEGACY_BACKUP, JSON.stringify({
          migratedAt: new Date().toISOString(), products: removedProducts, teachers: removedTeachers,
          notifications: removedNotifications, currentUser: previousSession,
        }));
      }
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PRODUCTS, JSON.stringify(products));
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TEACHERS, JSON.stringify(teachers));
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.NOTIFICATIONS, JSON.stringify(notifications));
      if (currentUser) localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CURRENT_USER, JSON.stringify(currentUser));
      else localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CURRENT_USER);
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.ECMC_ORCID_IMPORT, ECMC_IMPORT_VERSION);
      return true;
    });
    // Even if persistence is unavailable, render the factual dataset and retry later.
    return snapshot;
  } catch { return undefined; }
}

// Configuración de visibilidad pública
// Por defecto: Solo productos 'verificados' para visitantes; el propietario ve todos los suyos.
export interface PublicVisibilityConfig {
  showOnlyVerifiedForVisitors: boolean;
}

const DEFAULT_CONFIG: PublicVisibilityConfig = {
  showOnlyVerifiedForVisitors: true,
};

function academicDegreeFrom(value?: string): AcademicDegree | undefined {
  if (!value) return undefined;
  if (/\b(?:ph\.?\s*d|doctorad[oa]?|doctora?)\b/i.test(value)) return 'PhD';
  if (/\b(?:m\.?\s*sc|master|maestr[ií]a|mag[ií]ster)\b/i.test(value)) return 'MSc';
  if (/\b(?:b\.?\s*sc|ingenier[oa]|licenciatur[ao])\b/i.test(value)) return 'BSc';
  return undefined;
}

function academicFieldFrom(value?: string): string | undefined {
  const match = value?.match(/\b(?:en|de)\s+(.+)$/i);
  return match?.[1]?.trim() || undefined;
}

function normalizeTeacher(teacher: TeacherUser): TeacherUser {
  if (teacher.id.startsWith('ecmc-orcid-researcher-')) return teacher;
  const name = teacher.name || '';
  const namePrefix = name.match(/^\s*((?:m\.?\s*sc|ph\.?\s*d|dr|dra|ing|mag)\.?)\s+/i)?.[1];
  const cleanName = name.replace(/^\s*(?:(?:m\.?\s*sc|ph\.?\s*d|dr|dra|ing|mag)\.?)\s+/i, '').trim();
  const rankParts = (teacher.rank || 'Profesor').split(/\s*\/\s*/);
  const credentialIndex = rankParts.findIndex(part => academicDegreeFrom(part));
  const credential = credentialIndex >= 0 ? rankParts[credentialIndex] : undefined;
  const academicDegree = teacher.academicDegree || academicDegreeFrom(credential) || academicDegreeFrom(namePrefix);
  const academicField = teacher.academicField || academicFieldFrom(credential);
  const savedResearchLines = Array.isArray(teacher.researchLines) ? teacher.researchLines : teacher.researchLine ? [teacher.researchLine] : [];
  const researchLines = [...new Set(savedResearchLines)].filter((line): line is OfficialResearchLine => ALL_OFFICIAL_RESEARCH_LINES.includes(line));
  const rank = credential
    ? rankParts.filter((_, index) => index !== credentialIndex).join(' / ').trim() || 'Profesor'
    : teacher.rank || 'Profesor';

  return { ...teacher, name: cleanName, rank, academicDegree, academicField, researchLines: researchLines.length ? researchLines : undefined, researchLine: researchLines[0] };
}

export const storageService = {
  getProducts(): ScientificProduct[] {
    try {
      const imported = importEcmcStorage();
      if (imported) return imported.products;
      const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PRODUCTS);
      if (!data) {
        this.saveProducts(INITIAL_PRODUCT_DATA);
        return INITIAL_PRODUCT_DATA;
      }
      const storedProducts: ScientificProduct[] = JSON.parse(data);
      const existingIds = new Set(storedProducts.map(product => product.id));
      const newSchoolFixtures = INITIAL_SCHOOL_PRODUCTS.filter(product => !existingIds.has(product.id));
      const products = [...storedProducts, ...newSchoolFixtures];
      if (JSON.stringify(products) !== JSON.stringify(storedProducts)) this.saveProducts(products);
      return products;
    } catch {
      return INITIAL_PRODUCT_DATA;
    }
  },

  saveProducts(products: ScientificProduct[]): boolean {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PRODUCTS, JSON.stringify(products));
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error guardando productos en almacenamiento local:', err);
      return false;
    }
  },

  getTeachers(): TeacherUser[] {
    try {
      const imported = importEcmcStorage();
      if (imported) return imported.teachers.map(teacher => normalizeTeacher(completeSyntheticTeacher(teacher)));
      const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TEACHERS);
      if (!data) {
        const teachers = INITIAL_TEACHER_DATA.map(teacher => normalizeTeacher(completeSyntheticTeacher(teacher)));
        this.saveTeachers(teachers);
        return teachers;
      }
      const storedTeachers: TeacherUser[] = JSON.parse(data);
      const existingIds = new Set(storedTeachers.map(teacher => teacher.id));
      const newSchoolTeachers = INITIAL_SCHOOL_TEACHERS.filter(teacher => !existingIds.has(teacher.id));
      const teachers = [...storedTeachers, ...newSchoolTeachers].map(teacher => normalizeTeacher(completeSyntheticTeacher(teacher)));
      if (JSON.stringify(teachers) !== JSON.stringify(storedTeachers)) this.saveTeachers(teachers);
      return teachers;
    } catch {
      return INITIAL_TEACHER_DATA.map(teacher => normalizeTeacher(completeSyntheticTeacher(teacher)));
    }
  },

  saveTeachers(teachers: TeacherUser[]): boolean {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TEACHERS, JSON.stringify(teachers));
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error guardando docentes:', err);
      return false;
    }
  },

  getNotifications(): UserNotification[] {
    try {
      const imported = importEcmcStorage();
      if (imported) return imported.notifications;
      const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.NOTIFICATIONS);
      if (!data) {
        this.saveNotifications(INITIAL_NOTIFICATIONS);
        return INITIAL_NOTIFICATIONS;
      }
      const notifications: UserNotification[] = JSON.parse(data);
      return notifications;
    } catch {
      return INITIAL_NOTIFICATIONS;
    }
  },

  saveNotifications(notifs: UserNotification[]): boolean {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.NOTIFICATIONS, JSON.stringify(notifs));
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error guardando notificaciones:', err);
      return false;
    }
  },

  getCurrentUser(): TeacherUser | null {
    try {
      const imported = importEcmcStorage();
      if (imported) return imported.currentUser ? normalizeTeacher(completeSyntheticTeacher(imported.currentUser)) : null;
      const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CURRENT_USER);
      if (!data) return null;
      const storedUser: TeacherUser = JSON.parse(data);
      const user = normalizeTeacher(completeSyntheticTeacher(storedUser));
      if (JSON.stringify(user) !== JSON.stringify(storedUser)) this.setCurrentUser(user);
      return user;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  },

  setCurrentUser(user: TeacherUser | null): boolean {
    try {
      if (user) {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CURRENT_USER, JSON.stringify(user));
      } else {
        localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CURRENT_USER);
      }
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error guardando usuario actual:', err);
      return false;
    }
  },

  getPublicConfig(): PublicVisibilityConfig {
    try {
      const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PUBLIC_VISIBILITY_CONFIG);
      return data ? JSON.parse(data) : DEFAULT_CONFIG;
    } catch {
      return DEFAULT_CONFIG;
    }
  },

  savePublicConfig(config: PublicVisibilityConfig): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PUBLIC_VISIBILITY_CONFIG, JSON.stringify(config));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error guardando configuración pública:', err);
    }
  },

  resetToSeed(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PRODUCTS, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_PRODUCT_DATA));
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TEACHERS, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_TEACHER_DATA.map(teacher => normalizeTeacher(completeSyntheticTeacher(teacher)))));
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.NOTIFICATIONS, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_NOTIFICATIONS));
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PUBLIC_VISIBILITY_CONFIG, JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_CONFIG));
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.ECMC_ORCID_IMPORT, ECMC_IMPORT_VERSION);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error restableciendo datos:', err);
    }
  },
};
